# Frozen compact projection inputs

These are the maintained MVC/parser/JSON sources immediately before the 2026-11-22 Core 1.8
source modernization. They exercise the historical compact projection, whose grammar predates
contextual constructor inference. Current maintained examples use the native compiler directly.
The legacy MVC comparison remains unchanged. Do not update these inputs to follow live syntax.
